title: RatingDisplay
description: `RatingDisplay` is used to communicate user sentiment. By default, it shows rating as filled stars out of 5, as well as a text displaying the average value and the aggregate number of ratings.
bestPractices:
## Best practices

### Do

- Always display the value of the `RatingDisplay`.
- Display the total number of ratings if known.
- Use the `RatingDisplay` to represent only one thing.

### Don't

- Display an empty `RatingDisplay`.
- Display a `RatingDisplay` with no value.
